title: QMT135 2026 — official elevation chart and station kilometre table
claims: The QMT135 page's ELEVATION CHART accordion displays a 2,560 × 853 static JPG at https://ultratrailcanada.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/135-scaled.jpg; the chart itself prints no edition year.

The chart marks Baie-Saint-Paul at km 0, Halte de l'Arche at km 19.8, Le Massif at km 39.1, Cap du Salut at km 51.3, Cap Gribane at km 64.9, Saint-Tite-des-Caps at km 79.5, Mestachibo at km 90.4, MSA at km 101.5, Sommet 1 at km 105.7, Sommet 2 at km 110.3, Auberge du Fondeur at km 124.9 and the Mont-Sainte-Anne finish after a final 9.1 km segment.

The chart's segment gains are +922 m, +921 m, +407 m, +669 m, +591 m, +485 m, +465 m, +633 m (4.2 km), +393 m (4.6 km), +348 m (14.6 km) and +110 m (9.1 km); their sum is 5,944 m against the organiser's published +6,000 m, a 56 m difference left unallocated rather than averaged into any segment.

The chart's station kilometres differ from kilometre values on the text page: Saint-Tite-des-Caps 79.5 vs 80, MSA 101.5 vs 104.2, Auberge du Fondeur 124.9 vs 125, and the finish 134.0 (124.9 + 9.1) vs the French page's KM 135; both official versions are kept.

verification.note: 2026-11-22 在官方 QMT135 页打开 ELEVATION CHART 折叠块，读取其静态 JPG（2,560 × 853、246,996 字节）并下载逐项核对。图上标出 11 个分段的公里与 D+；逐段 D+ 相加为 5,944 m，与官方总数 6,000 m 相差 56 m。图件版权归组委会，未给出再分发许可。

claimVerification.note: 官方页 ELEVATION CHART 折叠块加载该 JPG；本地下载尺寸 2,560 × 853、246,996 字节，图上没有届次年份。
